nodes.label: Captio Case Notes Form UI (Spanish) - New Note Creation Screen
nodes.author: toledolaw
nodes.description: Screenshot of Captio app in Spanish locale showing the 'Notas de caso' (Case Notes) page for case #4 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' categorized as 'Negocios / contrato'. The form displays fields for: Titulo (title, with placeholder 'Ej. Estrategia inicial, Pendientes, Resumen de audiencia...'), Notas padre (parent notes, showing 'Aún no hay notas en este caso. Esta será una nota independiente.'), and Nota (note body with 'Escribe aquí...' placeholder). A 'Guardar nota' (Save note) button is visible. Left sidebar navigation shows: Nuevo Cliente, Clientes, Notas de caso (active/highlighted), Archivos. Language switcher at bottom shows ES (active) / EN options. User 'toledolaw' is logged in (top right). Layout: two-column with sidebar and main content area. Design uses blue accent color for active states and primary actions.
